verdict.rationale: Pulumi Policies is a first-party policy-as-code feature for defining guardrails in code and applying them across Pulumi-managed and other resources (pulumi-docs-5, pulumi-docs-16). Policy violations surface in pull request comments and checks (pulumi-docs-40), which fits a pre-apply review workflow alongside `pulumi preview` (pulumi-docs-8). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that violations block or fail an update before apply (e.g., mandatory enforcement levels), and independent or hands-on corroboration of enforcement.
